UNRESOLVED DISCREPANCY (flagged, not changed): the raw MT5 tick log (data/spread_log.jsonl) recorded this measurement under symbol 'SpotCrude' (display_name 'OIL'), not 'USOIL'. mt5_symbol is kept as 'USOIL' here only because scripts/tsm_paper_trade.py hardcodes MT5_SYMBOL_MAP['OIL']='USOIL' and indexes its cost lookup by that literal key (COST_MAP.get(mt5_sym, 10.0)) — changing this field to 'SpotCrude' would silently break that lookup and fall back to the 10bps default, discarding this real measurement.
